args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art game prop atlas, genuine transparent RGBA.
Make a NEW set of 16 environmental props to expand the approved Underworld-derived pixel metroidvania assets. Reference 1 is assembled art direction; reference 2 is the sprite craftsmanship to MATCH. Fine small pixel clusters, restrained lit edges, quiet dark interiors, no chunky cartoon outline, no fuzzy painting, no random noise. Side-on orthographic view, grounded surfaces, consistent soft upper-left light, no cast shadow or glow cloud outside objects.
Composition: 1536x1536 square sheet, 4 ROWS × 4 COLUMNS. One entire isolated prop per cell, centered, ample fully transparent gutters, no overlapping cells, no cropped edge. NO ground slab connecting sprites. No labels, no grid lines, no text/UI. Correct real alpha, no gray/checkerboard painted background.
Rows and columns:
ROW 1: Windchime Plains; materials wind-worn bluegray limestone, sage grass, subdued warm brass and ivory.
Column 1: a small broken wind-driven bell wheel on a timber fork.
Column 2: a slender sagging rope span hung with three small antique bells.
Column 3: a squat worn road marker with a hollow circular inset.
Column 4: a long grass and seedpod tuft entwined around a tiny clockwork relic.
ROW 2: Thorn Forest; materials dark brown fine bark, subdued olive moss, bluegreen shade, small faded ochre accents.
Column 1: an irregular hook-shaped hooked root growing sideways, full asymmetric silhouette.
Column 2: a hollow fallen thorn log with small spikes and open end.
Column 3: a small cluster of hanging tapered green and pale amber seedpods on a crooked root.
Column 4: an old stone hand bell swallowed by thin tangled roots.
ROW 3: Mushroom Caverns; materials muted mauve slate, turquoise cyan fungal tips, violet beige cap interiors.
Column 1: one broad asymmetric shelf fungus on a short rock stalk.
Column 2: three hanging translucent turquoise spore pods attached to a fine mycelium branch.
Column 3: an archless horizontal tangled mycelium span between two small purple stones.
Column 4: a hollow fallen purple mushroom cap with small cyan gills.
ROW 4: Firefly Marsh; materials quiet brown peat, olive reeds, desaturated bluegreen water stains and tiny yellowgreen tips.
Column 1: a short weathered reed and timber footbridge with two posts.
Column 2: a small leaning reed fishing frame with a hanging woven trap.
Column 3: a low fan of unusual long swamp seedpods on delicate reeds.
Column 4: a half-sunk circular metal relic covered in algae, with tiny pale firefly perches.
Make the four props in each row DIFFERENT shapes, not recolors. Complete natural silhouettes and delicate tips must fit wholly inside each cell. These are reusable visual props; leave clean alpha around. The native player is 44 pixels tall, and final props are around 56–148 native pixels wide, so choose fine clustered texture and readable structures at that size, not tiny photoreal wires. All the regions share the same pixel handcraft and shadow value structure as reference.
